availableCast.name: God / Yahweh, the Father and God of Israel
The Israelite people (the children of Israel)

scene.primarySubject: A dense cloud settling over the Tent of Meeting; brilliant white-gold radiance with a fire-like glow pouring through the tabernacle
scene.action: The cloud descends and covers the tent while light fills the sanctuary from within
scene.setting: Desert courtyard of the portable tabernacle with the camp's tents arranged in rows on sand and rock
scene.secondaryElements: Israelites in woven tunics and cloaks standing at tent doors, priests in linen garments near the tabernacle entrance
scene.timeOfDay: Late afternoon turning to dusk, still desert air under a slowly moving cloud
scene.composition: Wide view from the edge of the camp looking toward the tabernacle at centre, cloud above, camp rows receding on either side

availableCast.name: The Israelite people (the children of Israel)
God / Yahweh, the Father and God of Israel

scene.primarySubject: Israelite men, women and children walking in a long column through the middle of the sea, with Moses leading near the front.
scene.action: The people move steadily forward on dry ground between towering walls of water, carrying bundled belongings.
scene.setting: The wide sea basin at night, with a dry sea floor of wet sand and rock flanked by standing water walls, and distant shoreline beyond.
scene.secondaryElements: Water walls rising on either side with a glassy, suspended edge; a veiled radiance with a fire-like glow above the sea lighting the path from above; Moses in a plain cloak holding a staff.
scene.mood: Awe, fear and tense hope as the people cross in quiet procession.
scene.timeOfDay: Night turning toward dawn, clear dark sky with heavy low cloud banked over the sea, still air, no rain.
scene.composition: Elevated wide view looking down the length of the column, with the walls of water receding to either side and the people centered on the dry path.

availableCast.name: The Israelite people (the children of Israel)
God / Yahweh, the Father and God of Israel

scene.primarySubject: Mount Sinai enveloped in thick smoke, its slopes shaking
scene.action: Smoke billows upward from the peak like a furnace while fire-like glow and white-gold radiance veiled in cloud gather at its heart, and the ground trembles
scene.setting: Barren rocky wilderness at the foot and slopes of Horeb/Sinai with the Israelite camp below
scene.secondaryElements: Moses at the front of the gathered people, the Israelites standing at the lower slopes in woven tunics and cloaks, drifting ash and scattered rocks
scene.timeOfDay: Dusk darkening into night, smoke-dimmed sky, thunder-storm air
scene.composition: Wide view from the lower slopes looking up at the smoking mountain, with the people in the foreground and the peak filling the upper frame

availableCast.name: Jesus Christ, the Son of God and Lord
Wounded traveler in the Samaritan parable
Jerusalem–Jericho road in the Samaritan parable

scene.primarySubject: The Samaritan kneeling beside the wounded man, leaning forward as he tends his wounds.
scene.action: He pours oil and wine onto the wounds and binds them with strips of linen.
scene.setting: A rocky Judean road descending toward Jericho, with stone outcrops and dry scrub.
scene.secondaryElements: The wounded traveler lies half-raised on the road, bare-chested and bloodied; the Samaritan's animal stands nearby with its reins loose, not yet used to carry him; a flask and linen strips lie on the ground.
scene.timeOfDay: Midday heat easing toward late afternoon, clear dry sky.
scene.composition: Medium shot from the roadside at a low angle, the kneeling Samaritan and wounded man centered, with the animal and rocky road receding behind them.
